goal_ru: После урока ты сможешь сказать, как долго ты чем-то занимаешься, с for и since.
can_do_en: I can say how long I have done something using for and since.

words.example_en: How long have you lived here?
I've known Max for six years.
I've had this phone since May.
I've been in the chess club for two years.
words.example_ru: Я хожу в шахматный кружок два года.

words.example_en: I haven't seen him for ages!

grammar.title_ru: Present Perfect + for / since: то, что началось в прошлом и длится до сих пор
grammar.explain_ru: По-русски «я живу здесь 5 лет» — в настоящем. По-английски — Present Perfect, потому что началось давно и продолжается: I've lived here for five years. for — СКОЛЬКО времени (for 5 years, for two weeks, for ages). since — С КАКОГО момента (since 2021, since Monday, since I was ten). Вопрос: How long have you…? Начало — Past Simple: I started in 2021.
grammar.explain_en: Started in the past and still true: Present Perfect + for/since. I've lived here for five years / since 2021. How long have you known him? for + period, since + point in time.

examples.en: How long have you played basketball? — For four years, since I was eleven.
examples.ru: Сколько ты играешь в баскетбол? — Четыре года, с одиннадцати лет.

examples.en: I've known my best friend since first grade.
examples.ru: Я знаю лучшего друга с первого класса.

examples.en: We've had our dog for two months.

mistakes.wrong: I live here for five years.
mistakes.right: I've lived here for five years.
mistakes.why_ru: Длится до сих пор — Present Perfect.

mistakes.wrong: How long do you know him?
mistakes.right: How long have you known him?

grammar.tutor_notes_ru: Главная калька русских: «I live here for 5 years». Ловить в каждой фразе. Ось времени на экране: since — точка, for — отрезок. Тема — спорт и кружки, дружба, гаджеты.

questions_en: How long have you lived in your city?
How long have you known your best friend?
What clubs are you in? Since when?
How long have you had your phone?
talk.tutor_notes_ru: Нейт задаёт How long…? про всё подряд — ученик отвечает и сам спрашивает Нейта (How long have you been a tutor?).

tasks.text: I've been in the robotics club ___ 2023. I've known Max ___ six years. We haven't seen our cousins ___ ages.

tasks.question: Я знаю его с детства.
options: I know him since I was a kid.
I've known him since I was a kid.
I've known him for I was a kid.
tasks.answer: I've known him since I was a kid.

tasks.from_ru: Сколько ты уже играешь на гитаре?
tasks.answer: How long have you played the guitar?

tasks.ask_ru: Послушай без текста. Сколько лет Дима в команде?
tasks.ask_en: Listen. How long has Dima been in the team?
tasks.audio: I started playing hockey when I was six. I've been in this team since 2022, so that's about four years. And I've had these skates for only two months — they're new!
tasks.question: Сколько лет он в этой команде?

tasks.ask_ru: Расскажи о 4 вещах в твоей жизни: как давно (for/since) и когда началось (Past Simple).
tasks.ask_en: Four things in your life: how long and when did it start?
tasks.say: Four things: your city, your best friend, your hobby, your phone. How long? Since when?
tasks.example: I've lived in Chelyabinsk since I was born. I've known Max for eight years — we met in kindergarten. I've been into coding since 2023. And I've had my phone for a year, but it's already old.

homework.about_ru: Итог модуля «Опыт»: «ось времени моей жизни» голосом — 5 событий с датами (Past Simple) и что продолжается до сих пор (for/since).

tasks.say: Your life timeline. Dates and things that are still true.
tasks.example: I was born in 2011. I started school in 2018. We moved to this flat in 2020, so I've lived here for six years. I started coding in 2023, and I've been in the olympiad team since last year.

pass.about_ru: Пройден, если верно 75% заданий и в рассказе (t5) нет кальки «I live here for…».
